title: Avin bar Huna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.66b) and [139b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.139b), Avin bar Huna transmits several teachings in the name of Rav Chama bar Gurya.[^1]
[Zevachim 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.62b) has “Abaye bar Huna”; the reading in *Shitta Mekubbetzet* and *Dikdukei Soferim* is “Avin bar Huna.”

notes.text: Shabbat 139b names him “Rabbi Avin bar Rav Huna”; the reports on 66b give “Avin bar Huna.”
